text:
Ada Park: quick visual request — need a 'Pulse Pack' for the webinar: 1) one-page PDF (US letter) with a compact benchmark chart (dual sparkline: latency vs cost) + tiny 3-step inbound routing diagram, 2) two social headers (1200x628 and 800x800), 3) registration hero (1600x900). Brand-safe palette only. Deadline Tue 5pm PST.
Maria Chen: got it. Tone split: tech = data-dense, exec = business impact bullets. I’ll do two social variants.
Eli Navarro: sample data: latency_ms=[40,52,60,70], cost_per_1k=[0.40,0.28,0.18,0.10]. Prefer overlay with dual y-axis; fallback to side-by-side sparklines. Alt text: "Sparkline showing latency rising from 40ms to 70ms while cost per 1k tokens falls from $0.40 to $0.10."
brand-bot: Brand checklist — primary REDWOOD-500 #B91C1C + neutrals; fonts Inter (body), GT Aligned (headings); max 2 typefaces; contrast >=4.5:1; export @2x. Include footer: "© Redwood Inference 2026 — Internal benchmark summary". Link: https://brand/redwood-guidelines
Jordan Li: ops routing fields: campaign=pulse_wm, lead_tag=pulse_bench. When score>=70 -> owner_pool=bench_sales; default lead_priority=medium. I’ll send mapping sheet to ops.
Maria Chen: filenames: pulse_onepager_v1.pdf, pulse_social_1200x628.png, pulse_social_800x800.png, pulse_reg_1600x900.jpg. Source Figma: /brand/marketing/pulse. Initial comps by Mon EOD, revisions Tue morning, final Tue 5pm.
Ada Park: perfect — please @me when comps are ready. Include tiny 3-step diagram: 1) Register -> 2) Ops qualify -> 3) Book demo (mono-line icons). Thanks!
